description:
The reconciler is **not** a GenServer. It is a pure functional
module over an immutable `%UI.State{}` value:

  * `UI.State.new(root_component, props)` — initial state.
  * `UI.State.handle_key(state, %Key{}) :: state` — fold a key event
    through hook subscriptions, return updated state.
  * `UI.State.handle_event(state, term) :: state` — same for
    arbitrary messages routed to a hole (streaming snapshots,
    timer wakeups, etc.).
  * `UI.State.tick(state, now_ms) :: state` — advance frame clock;
    invalidates any holes whose `use_frame` deadline has passed.
  * `UI.State.paint(state, %RenderContext{}) :: {state, iodata, cursor_or_nil}`
    — single-pass paint; returns updated state (memo cache,
    visited-cell GC) plus the bytes the renderer will diff.
  * `UI.State.next_wait_ms(state) :: non_neg_integer() | :infinity`
    — earliest pending deadline across every active `use_frame`
    cell, expressed as ms-from-now. Interactive's existing
    receive/after loop reads this to set its next timeout.

Hook handle `h` carries a reference to the hole's cell within the
state value; `use_state(h, init) -> {value, setter}` returns a
setter that, when called, returns a new state value (no message
sends). State updates flow through the same return-the-state
pattern Interactive already uses.

`Interactive` keeps its existing GenServer + RenderLoop; the only
addition is calling `UI.State.paint/2` instead of `build_screen/2`,
and using `UI.State.next_wait_ms/1` to schedule its next tick.
RenderLoop is unchanged.

Hooks delivered: `use_state`, `use_memo`, `use_frame`, `use_key`,
`use_effect`. Hook-cell GC: cells not visited during a paint are
retained one frame, then dropped — implemented as a generation
counter on the state value, no GenServer timers.

Tests: pure-function tests over `UI.State` — feed a key sequence,
assert the resulting state's painted bytes; assert `next_wait_ms`
coalesces correctly across multiple animated holes; assert memo
invalidation triggers repaint of just the affected subtree.
title: Reconciler state + hooks (pure functions; Interactive drives the loop)
